name: representation-mosaic
description: The Representation Mosaic: historic firsts of the 2026 midterms (static site for Cloudflare Pages)

scripts.build: node scripts/build-data.mjs && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i src/input.css -o dist/css/site.css --minify && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('node_modules/chart.js/dist/chart.umd.min.js','dist/js/chart.umd.min.js')"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name representation-mosaic --branch main
